clips.title: The story
paras: "Fallen Sky Lake" is the emotional culmination of Pelturas Whitemoon's quest chain to save his dying daughter, Relara, in Astranaar. Although her initial fever has broken, her vitality remains dangerously depleted, requiring a celestial moonstone to restore her life force. Players must journey into the untamed waters of Fallen Sky Lake to wrest one of these hoarded stones from a corrupted Shadethicket Oracle.

Pelturas Whitemoon has spent agonizing days watching his young daughter, Relara, slip closer to death. While powerful curatives brewed from Bathran's hair and stardust helped break her raging fever, the ordeal left her body hollowed and frail. Time is no longer on her side; Pelturas fears that without supernatural intervention, she has only breaths remaining before her spirit fades permanently into the night.

To revitalize the girl, Pelturas turns to the magic of the moonstones—celestial fragments that once fell freely into the waters of Fallen Sky Lake, southeast of Astranaar. Traditionally gathered by the night elves for their restorative properties, these remnants of lunar grace have been claimed by aggressive elemental or corrupted bark, making their collection a matter of blade and spell rather than peaceful harvesting.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Relara's fever has passed, but she is still very weak. I do not believe time alone will give her back the strength she has lost. I believe it will take the power of a moonstone.
We used to gather moonstones at Fallen Sky Lake to the southeast... Until the Shadethickets came.
Their leader, a Shadethicket Oracle, gathered up all the fallen moonstones and hoards them. Now, you must retrieve a moonstone from the Oracle.
And to do that, I fear that you must slay him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you face the Shadethicket Oracle, friend? If so, then please hand me the fallen moonstone. Relara has strength left for only a few more breaths!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, friend, you have saved my daughter! I know the power of the moonstone will give back my daughter her strength!
I can never repay you fully for the aid you have given me, but... Please, take this. Other than Relara, it is my most dear possession.
